traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified:
- File-level template insertion for missing @supports is implemented via ensureFileSupportsAnnotation/buildSupportsTemplateComment/insertSupportsTemplate, with a clear placeholder story path, REQ IDs, and an explicit TODO line. Tests assert the exact before/after output, fulfilling REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE and REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER. - Malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in test names are safely normalized by normalizeReqPrefixInDescription and normalizeReqId, and wired through handleItOrTestCall. Tests cover spacing, underscores, casing, and parentheses, fulfilling REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT. - Safety and non-inference guarantees (REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) are enforced by only providing fixers when a recognizable REQ pattern is already present and the first argument is a string literal; when the prefix is completely missing, the rule reports an error without offering an auto-fix. - Formatting and behavior preservation (REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE) are handled by inserting only comments at safe positions, preserving shebangs, and rewriting only the string literal value while keeping quoting and escaping consistent; tests confirm that only the intended parts of the code change. - The rule is integrated into the plugin export and recommended/strict configurations, and its auto-fix capabilities and template format are documented in user-docs/api-reference.md, satisfying the Integration and Documentation acceptance criteria. - Targeted Jest tests for require-test-traceability that explicitly reference Story 021.0 and its requirement IDs all pass, and the full test suite passes, providing strong evidence that the implementation is correct and stable.
Based on this concrete implementation, test coverage, and documentation, the story is fully implemented and meets its Definition of Done.
